title: chart.bar
description: Horizontal or vertical bars from a CSV, one per category, with a direct value label at each bar's end and an optional interval whisker, or a waterfall of contributions that add up to a running total (`mode`). The value axis stays fixed across steps, categories can appear one by one, and switching `y` shrinks or grows the bars.

data.description: Path to a CSV file, relative to the deck root. One row per category.

x.description: Column holding the category of each row (its text labels the band). Each category appears in one row only.

y.description: Column holding the numeric value of each bar. Changing it tweens every bar to its new length; the value axis only moves when the domain does.

interval.description: A whisker from the lower to the upper column at the end of each bar (e.g. an uncertainty interval). It is drawn after its bar and moves with it.

x.description: d3-format spec for category labels, applied when the category column is numeric (e.g. years).

y.description: d3-format spec for value labels, ticks and the interval text.

format.description: Label formats (d3-format, localized by the deck language, so a Spanish deck gets the decimal comma). Without `y`, ticks use a fixed precision from the tick step and value labels show the value as it is.

axes.description: Axis titles: `x` names the category axis, `y` the value axis, whichever way the bars point.

orient.description: Bar direction: `horizontal` (categories down the left, the default) or `vertical` (categories along the bottom).

sort.description: Order of the bars. "none" (the default) keeps the data order; "value" orders by `y`, lowest first, and "-value" highest first; { by, order } orders by another column (ascending unless `order` is "desc"); a list of categories puts those first, in that order, and the rest after them in data order. Ties keep data order and bars without a value come last, whichever way it runs. Hidden categories keep their place in the order. When it changes on a played step, every bar, with its label and whisker, slides to its new place; a bar that appears grows in at its place. An unknown column or category is an element error naming it.

mode.description: How the bars stand. "bars" (the default): every bar runs from zero. "waterfall": the rows, in display order, are contributions that stack into a running total over the shown bars only, each bar running from the total before it to the total after it, with dotted connectors between them; increases take the diverging palette's high colour and decreases its low colour (`invert` swaps them), value labels are signed, and `total` adds a final bar. The value axis then covers the running totals of every waterfall step of the slide. Every category needs a value: an empty one is an element error naming it. Changing it on a played step morphs each bar between standing on zero and floating on the running total.

total.description: With `mode: "waterfall"`, a last bar from zero to the sum of the shown bars, in the theme's ink, joined to the last bar by a connector. `true` labels it with the engine string ("Total"), a string with that text. Its band is kept on every step of the slide, so it fades in and out without moving the other bars.

invert.description: With `mode: "waterfall"`, swaps the colours: increases take the diverging palette's low colour and decreases its high one, for a chart where a reduction is the good news.

shown.description: Categories to show, by name. Omit to show every category. A category that appears grows from zero and then draws its whisker; one that leaves does the reverse. Hidden categories keep their band. An unknown category is an element error naming it.

highlight.description: Category to emphasize; the other bars turn the theme's dim color (never faded, so labels keep their contrast). Usually set with `only` so it lasts one step. An unknown category is an element error naming it.

domain.description: Fixed value axis as [min, max], used as given. Set it when `y` changes between steps so the shrink or growth stays visible. Without it the axis spans every row of the current `y` (and the interval columns), shown or not, from zero, rounded outward to tick values.

types.description: CSV column types, passed to the data loader. Undeclared columns are numbers only when every value looks like one.
